notes:
CRM notes:
- Profile: Ridgeview is a B2B SaaS vendor (customer knowledge base/rag for their support product).
- Architecture today: ingest pipeline -> S3 for blobs, ES + Redis for metadata + custom lightweight ANN (homegrown) for hot queries. Index ~1.2M docs (avg doc 1-2KB), growing ~10k/mo.
- Workload: high QPS read-heavy search on KB, spikes to 800-1k QPS during product incidents; target steady 250-500 QPS.
- Requirements: embeddings + ANN + reranking chain; they want hosted_api to avoid infra ops. Need reranker step after retrieval for precision (re-rank top 100).
- Latency targets: p50 <120ms, p95 end-to-end (embed+search+rerank) <=200-250ms depending on query. Throughput: sustained 500 QPS with bursting to 1k.
- Indexing: moderate scale (1M-2M documents), frequent updates (ingest pipeline daily). Care about incremental upserts and freshness.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement wants cost-per-query <= $0.03 for standard queries, willing to accept higher for priority customers; exploring committed usage for discounts.
- Models: prefer open/compatible models (Llama2/Mistral) but will evaluate Redwood-verified reranker & smaller low-cost fallback for heavy traffic. Interested in intelligent batching, prefix cache & per-route configs.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs + KMS for keys, retention controls and US data residency. Legal needs DPA + SOC2 Type II before signing.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable economics — if 500 QPS costs 10x more than today we can't flip the switch."
- POC plan: 2-week test: feed 100k real queries (anonymized) through hosted inference, measure recall@10, reranker latency, cost per q.
- Internal champions: Head of Product (Eva Torres), Support Eng lead (Samir Patel).
- Next: finalize POC success metrics, price worksheet for committed tiers, schedule security review follow-up (legal + security on 2026-03-18).
- Misc links: pricing deck shared in Drive, security FAQ in Drive, Jira RWD-3421 for SOC2 request.
